presentation.label: DigiReel
presentation.summary: A time-warp pedal for the Digitone's inputs: a tape that always listens, played back at -2x to +2x, reversed, held and stuttered in time with the tempo.
presentation.overview: DigiReel, by irpina, is a time-warp pedal for the Digitone mk1's audio inputs. The inputs go onto a tape that always listens, and a head plays it back at -2x to +2x, backwards included, in windows in time with the Digitone's tempo. The pitch follows the speed (TAPE) or stays apart from it (STRETCH); HOLD loops a window, TAPE STOP brings the tape to a stop, random events change the speed, the pitch or the direction or stutter on the beat, and a step slicer gates the result.
highlights: Speed from -2x through a stop to +2x, reverse included.
TAPE ties the pitch to the speed; STRETCH keeps them apart.
HOLD loops a window in time with the tempo; TAPE STOP stops the tape.
Random speed, pitch, reverse and stutter events, and a step slicer.
usage: Hold a track key, pick DIGIREEL in the Mod Menu and press YES.
Play into the inputs and turn SPED on page 1 (SYN1) left of the middle to play backwards.
Press T1 to HOLD the window that just played.
Press NO to turn DigiReel off and get the synths back.

access.location: Mod Menu: hold a track key
steps: Use a build containing DigiReel for the Digitone mk1 on OS 1.43 or 1.44; fxkit comes with it.
Hold a track key: the Mod Menu opens. Pick DIGIREEL and press YES.
Play into the inputs; NO turns it off and gives the synths back.

controls.name: Mod Menu (hold a track key)
controls.doc: Open DigiReel: it takes the audio engine and its page shows. Its Mod Menu entry also brings the page back after MIDI.

controls.name: SYN1, SYN2, FLTR
controls.doc: Its three pages: page 1 Reel (SPED, PTCH, TIME, BLND), page 2 Secondary (grains, crossfade, random weights, width), page 3 Modes (TAPE or STRETCH, direction, HOLD, capture). Pushing a knob sets it back to its default.

controls.name: AMP
controls.doc: The mixer: the inputs' levels and pans, balance, volume and width.

controls.name: LFO
controls.doc: Two LFOs on the stock LFO page; DEST aims them at its controls or the mixer.

controls.name: RECORD
controls.doc: LOCK mode: hold a trig and turn a control to lock it on that step; FUNC + a trig clears the step.

controls.name: MIDI
controls.doc: The stock UI for the MIDI tracks while it keeps playing.

controls.name: NO
controls.doc: Turn it off: the synths and the Digitone's own effects come back.

controls.name: T1
controls.doc: HOLD: loop a window (momentary or latching, the window just played or the next, set on page 3).

limitations: While it is the active effect it owns the audio engine: the synths are silent and the Digitone's own effects are off. NO gives them back; the sequencer keeps running.
Its MIDI CCs follow the Red Panda Tensor's published CC chart, so a controller set up for that pedal works with it. It is not affiliated with Red Panda and uses none of its code.
A beta from its author; not yet run on a Digitone Keys.
Its buffers use 2 MB of the Digitone's bulk memory (0x47700000-0x47900000), apart from the other effect pedals'.
Needs fxkit (it comes with it) and core 4.1 or newer, so on OS 1.44 it does not build beside KitBank 0.2.0, which builds only on the older core.

load.display: Runs in the audio render while it is the active effect, nothing while it is off
load.conditions: From the source: its render handlers process the inputs only while it owns the audio (fxkit's core_audio owner); its other handlers run on the UI side. The author's CPU readings are from the emulator only. Not measured on a unit in Modwerk.

hardware.summary: The author tested DigiReel 0.2 on a Digitone mk1 (release v0.2, 18 October 2026; built before the effects' rename, which changed only names) and checked it in digikit's emulator on OS 1.43 and 1.44. It is still a beta. This module pins the released files.
limitations: The author's report names no OS release, date or duration: testedOn is the v0.2 release date, and 1.44 is the newest OS its files support.
Not run on a Digitone Keys.
Not tested in Modwerk on a unit.

tests.summary: The author's released 0.2 files, pinned unchanged, linked locally with core 5.4 and Modwerk's fxkit 0.1.0: alone, beside each of the other five effect pedals, all six together, and beside DigiHealth and DigiTables on OS 1.43; on OS 1.44 every pair but KitBank (core 2.x only). Emulator captures show where it appears; nothing ran on a unit in Modwerk.
